subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this branch keep the internal-orphan drop strategy after fixing the background-trigger regression, or should maintainers choose the broader session-repair strategy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 instead?
rationale: Both branches target the same stale-reply cluster but encode different session-state semantics, and automation cannot choose the permanent repair contract for internal handoff content.

options.title: Narrow and prove this branch
options.body: Require a trigger guard or explicit background-trigger coverage, plus redacted embedded-agent proof for both internal drop and `sessions_send` preservation before merge.

options.title: Use the broader candidate
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers decide the metadata-aware repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 is the canonical fix path.

options.title: Accept broad internal drops
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers explicitly want all six internal handoff source tools removed from orphan repair whenever any non-empty prompt exists.

recommendation.title: Narrow and prove this branch
recommendation.body: Require a trigger guard or explicit background-trigger coverage, plus redacted embedded-agent proof for both internal drop and `sessions_send` preservation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in the merged active-turn repair.
